defects.description: The merge walks the keys a decoded envelope names without refusing a prototype key, so an envelope carrying __proto__ reaches Object.prototype through the descent and every object in the process gains the attacker's property.

trigger.expected: D1 merge({}, {"__proto__":{"polluted":"yes"}}) -> threw envelope: option __proto__ is not allowed ({}).polluted: undefined -> undefined

defects.why_missed: The suite merges option keys the plugin declares (timeoutMs, retries, headers) and never sends a key that names a prototype slot, so the descent is only exercised on the shape of object it was written for.

defects.description: headerMap assigns each line into the map by lowercased name, so a name that appears more than once keeps only the last value, although the README promises every value in order and Set-Cookie loses the session cookie.
defects.why_missed: Every header list in the suite gives each name once, so the assignment is exercised only where a name cannot collide with an earlier one.
